verdict.rationale: mise is a locally installed CLI that runs entirely on the user's own machines and CI. It installs as a local binary via an install script or mise-action, its source is published on GitHub (jdx/mise), and it can even provision remote hosts the user controls over SSH, so no vendor-hosted service sits between the user and the core product. The docs also note that registry data and tool downloads come from upstream hosts such as GitHub and npm. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, documented offline/air-gapped operation, self-hostable registry or mirror support.
